IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pagerduty alert triggered for service=inference-service-canary — 5xx rate spiked to 48% over last 3m. Alert runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-5xx
Alice Chen: I'm on it, paging @Ben Ortiz for CI context. Can someone paste the canary deployment id?
Ben Ortiz: digging, saw a deployment at 2026-03-15T01:07Z from the latest CI. pipeline job #4821 succeeded but the image tag looks odd.
Carla Mendoza: I noticed canary pods restarting and failing liveness. Logs show model load errors referencing a different model sha.
Ben Ortiz: looking at registry, the tag `redwood/inference:stable-latest` was overwritten by an intermediate CI artefact — appears to be a broken build pushed due to mutable tag caching.
Evan (sre): If the wrong image is in canary, we should stop rollout and rollback. Any customer-facing impact yet?
Alice Chen: Early telemetery: ~5% of traffic hit canary; user-facing errors confined to a small subset of requests (retryable). Support flagged 2 customer complaints. Low but not zero. Marking potential customer impact.
Alice Chen: Action plan: 1) Pause traffic to canary 2) Rollback canary deployment 3) Invalidate mutable tag in registry and trigger CI fix 4) Start handoff notes.
Ben Ortiz: paused canary route in router: `POST /internal/router/shunt?service=inference-canary` — done. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: deploy job 4821 started a rolling update on deployment inference-service-canary with image redwood/inference:stable-latest
Alice Chen: roll forward is bad, we need to undo. Evan, can you run rollback?
Evan (sre): Running:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-service-canary --to-revision=17
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-service-canary -o wide
```
Evan (sre): rollback applied, old replica set 17 is scaling up. Watching pod readiness.
Carla Mendoza: pods are coming up, model loads fine. 5xx rate dropping. Alice, please confirm router resume?
Alice Chen: waiting until 5xx < 1% for 2 consecutive minutes. Telemetry at 30s: 5xx=0.8% — good.
Alice Chen: router resume: `POST /internal/router/resume?service=inference-canary` — resumed. Monitoring for regressions.
Ben Ortiz: root cause so far: CI mutable tag allowed a partial/failed build to be pushed to :stable-latest because of docker cache/mirror race. CI Pipeline Bot: job 4821 logs attached: https://ci.redwood/internal/4821/logs
CI Pipeline Bot: found `docker push` completed but digest mismatch vs expected artifact manifest; likely cache poisoning on builder node.
Carla Mendoza: I've flagged the builder pool and quarantined the node with stale cache. Steps to remediate: 1) purge local caches on builders 2) make image tags immutable (use digests) 3) add CI validation to compare pushed manifest digest with pipeline artifact digest.
Ben Ortiz: adding temporary guard: CI will now always push with a timestamped tag and then update the stable tag via a controlled job that verifies digests. I'll open a PR for the pipeline change.
Alice Chen: LaunchDarkly Bot: toggled feature flag `inference.use_canary_images` to OFF to prevent future auto-canary use until CI fix is validated.
LaunchDarkly Bot: feature flag `inference.use_canary_images` is now OFF by Alice Chen.
Evan (sre): leaving a handoff note for morning oncall: canary rollback succeeded, router resumed, 5xx rate is stable ~0.4%, builder node id:bldr-07 quarantined, CI job change in progress. Please follow up with CI team to rotate builder credentials and run full artifact validation sweep.
Alice Chen: Paging summary for incident report: incident_type=deploy-misbuild, severity=sev2 (small customer impact), mitigation=rollback+feature-flag-off+builder-quarantine, followups: CI pipeline immutable tags + digest validation, runbook update for mutable-tags, communicate to support 2 affected customers.
Ben Ortiz: I'll open the followup tickets and link to this thread.
Carla Mendoza: quick postmortem note: consider adding a registry webhook alarm for digest surprises.
Alice Chen: thanks all. Closing this thread once followups are created. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Incident closed (auto) — duration ~23m. Refer to incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-03-15-cicd-misbuild-4821
